about.title: About
about.berlinVotesBody: Every 5 years Berlin votes for a new parliament that will shape the city's policies.
about.accessibilityBody: About 16% of German citizens in Berlin have a migration background. Election programs are only published in German and can run up to 200 pages. That's a hard read even for native speakers. Wahl-O-Mat helps, but it's not built to go deep.
about.clarityBody: Much of the 200 pages is rhetoric, hard to translate into anything concrete. We wanted tangible answers separating commitments tied to numbers from general statements of intent.
about.whatWeDidBody: We compared the positions of 10 Berlin parties against key points across transport and urban spaces, climate and energy — and turned their programs into one side-by-side table focused on eco topics.
about.beforeYouVoteBody: The table is made with the help of AI, and we recommend double-checking important information: full translations of the main parties' programs are published on [BerlinVote.Help](https://www.berlinvote.help/).
about.disclaimer: This project is not campaign material and is not affiliated with any party.

aiDisclosure.title: AI Disclosure
aiDisclosure.intro: This page explains how we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools when creating content for this website, and how human editors remain responsible for what we publish.
aiDisclosure.howWeUseAiContent: We use AI tools to help draft and refine website text — for example, page copy and summaries of official party election programs. AI assists with wording, structure, and extracting comparable positions; it does not decide what we publish or how you should vote.
aiDisclosure.humanResponsibilityContent: All ideas, goals, and substantive decisions behind this website come from people working on the Berlin 2026 project. Before anything is published, content is reviewed for clarity and fit with the project’s informational purpose. Editorial responsibility for this website lies with the Berlin 2026 project (contact: Nina Harz).
aiDisclosure.reviewAndAccuracyContent: The party comparison table is compiled with substantial AI assistance from official party programs. We recommend double-checking points that matter to you. Full translations of the main parties’ programs are published on BerlinVote.Help. We check content for accuracy, but errors and lost nuances can still occur. If you spot a mistake, please let us know.
aiDisclosure.contactContent: Questions about how we use AI or about the content on this site? Write to us at nina.harz@pm.me.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection laws.
privacy.responsiblePartyContent:
Berlin 2026 project
Contact: Nina Harz
Email: nina.harz@pm.me
privacy.dataProcessedContent:
When you visit our website, our hosting provider may automatically process technical data required to deliver the site (for example IP address, browser type, and request timestamps in server logs). We do not operate our own user accounts and we do not ask you for your name or email on this site.

This technical processing is based on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in providing a secure, functioning website.
privacy.hostingContent: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. Server infrastructure and content delivery may involve processing outside the EU under appropriate safeguards. See [Vercel's Privacy Policy](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy) for details.
privacy.purposeOfProcessingContent:
We process technical data only to:

• Provide and maintain this website
• Detect, prevent and address technical issues
• Ensure the security and proper functioning of the site

This processing is necessary for our legitimate interests in providing the service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.cookiesContent: This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies. The language preference may be stored in a small cookie or local storage so we can show your chosen language on return visits. You can delete cookies and site data in your browser settings at any time.
privacy.yourRightsIntro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.yourRightsList:
• Right to access (Art. 15 GDPR): You have the right to request access to your personal data
• Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal data
• Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You have the right to request deletion of your personal data
• Right to restrict processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data
• Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You have the right to request transfer of your personal data
• Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): You have the right to object to processing of your personal data
• Right to lodge a complaint (Art. 77 GDPR): You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
privacy.contactInfo: If you wish to exercise any of these rights or have questions about your data, please contact us at nina.harz@pm.me.
